lessons: The fence misses a file the change forces: tests/test_host_running.py::test_verb_table_matches_parser checks that the verb table in docs/host-running.md matches the CLI parser exactly. Add docs/host-running.md to the scope fence and give stats a row in its verb table.

After the fence is fixed, keep the fenced implementation. The run record says the targeted tests in tests/test_stats.py and tests/test_stages.py passed, and the only full-suite failure that blocked the run was the host-running verb table.

tests/test_fixture_host.py::test_fixture_scaffold_is_dormant compares snapshots of the bytes under chupa/, so editing chupa/stats.py while ./dev.py test runs makes it fail. Finish all edits first, then run ./dev.py test once with no edits in flight.

Once the fence is corrected, run chupa review stats-command and fix every finding until it approves. Check for any other test that lists CLI verbs or dev.py subcommands and would force a file outside the fence.
